name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park, CA) Guava "Besito" Butter Shortbread Cookie
whyItWorks: Melt-in-your-mouth Cuban butter shortbread cookie filled with smooth, strained seedless guava jam and dusted in powdered sugar. Completely seed-free and gentle.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a box of Guava Besito cookies for snacking during your Knott's Berry Farm day.
